finish.text: Done and verified. Cheapest available item in the Electronics category: "USB-C Charging Cable 6ft" by CableTech, $7.99, Prime eligible, In Stock (sold by Amazon.com). Added it via the product page 'Add to Cart' button, then reopened the cart and reloaded it to confirm against fresh state: 1 line item 'USB-C Charging Cable 6ft', price 7.99, quantity 1, 'Subtotal (1 item): 7.99', header cart badge 1 item - unchanged after reload, so the addition persisted rather than being an optimistic UI update.
